entry_state: The compound tax difference reverses through earnings under explicit fiscal facts; equal diluted EPS need not mean equal cash obligations. Apple's averages allow different dated share histories. Award balances, plan reserves, delivered shares and cash remain distinct populations. The performance-award form now raises the question of missing thresholds and actual grant terms.
exit_state: Performance awards require the applicable schedule, return observations, employment conditions and delivery terms. Later forms change surviving rights without proving an earlier grant was amended. Debt schedules distinguish contractual payment from carrying value; modification, default and compound settlement retain separate rules. The early-repurchase valuation has begun and continues with its precision and inducement cases.
findings: The performance multiplier jumps at percentile25; filling the interval between possible outcomes would invent unsupported awards.
The absolute-return cap depends on the specified observation windows, not merely the first and last prices. Relative rank does not identify the sign of return.
General and CEO forms imply different survival quantities while retaining later delivery; applicable versions and grant facts remain necessary.
Fees, compounding, modification and default cannot be handled by retaining an old convenient rate or cancelling unpaid debt. No new confirmed defect.
